h: Spain coach responds after Lamine Yamal misses out on the Ballon d'Or to Harry Kane
p: Spain's national team coach has spoken publicly after Lamine Yamal finished behind Harry Kane in the 2026 Ballon d'Or voting. He is said to have praised the teenager's season and urged him to keep working.
more: Yamal was the runner-up behind England captain Kane.
Fans online are still debating the result.
Yamal is expected to return to action for his club this week.
